entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: BJ CGI 2023 (complete code held): no tax on net wealth; full-text search for 'impôt sur la fortune', 'impôt sur le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net' finds no charging provision

entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts 2023 (loi n° 2021-15 du 23 décembre 2021, mise à jour LF 2023 loi 2022-33)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes (fixed duty on turnover + proportional duty on rental value; Cotonou, 1st zone)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 199, 202, 204-205 (loi n° 2021-15 du 20 décembre 2021; edition 2023, later finance laws not held)
entries.doc: art. 202: general tariff, 1st zone 70 000 F up to 1 billion of the previous year's turnover, plus 10 000 F per billion or fraction above; art. 205: proportional duty on the premises' rental value, 17 % in Cotonou and Porto-Novo, at least a third of the fixed duty.
unsupported: importer/exporter tariff on imports and exports (art. 203), 2nd zone (60 000 F) and the other communes' rates (12-25 %, art. 205), household-waste levy 2 000-50 000 F set by councils (art. 199-2), supplementary patente 0,5 % on public contracts (art. 207), first-12-months exemption (art. 198)

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: BJ: the general tax code held (CGI-2023.txt, 627k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (private vehicles by fiscal horsepower; company passenger cars)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 166, 168 1) and 4) (edition 2023, later finance laws not held)
entries.doc: art. 168: private transport vehicles up to 7 CV 20 000 F, 8-10 CV 30 000, 11-15 CV 40 000, above 15 CV 60 000; passenger vehicles owned or used by companies 150 000 F up to 7 CV, 200 000 F above.
unsupported: public transport tariff by seats / tonnage and three-wheelers (art. 168 2-3)
prorata for vehicles first registered during the year (art. 169)

entries.name: IRCM on dividends (10 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 86 2) (edition 2023, later finance laws not held)
entries.doc: art. 86: 10 % on dividends other than those paid to non-residents or by listed companies (5 %); 15 % on other capital income.
unsupported: 5 % on dividends of companies listed on the BRVM and to non-residents (art. 86 1)

entries.name: IRCM on interest from claims and deposits (15 %)
Taxe sur les plus-values immobilières (5 % of the gain)
unsupported: minimum of 1 % of the sale price (art. 115 2)
construction gain set at 10 % of its price (art. 113)

entries.name: Taxe foncière unique (default rates 6 % built on rental value, 5 % unbuilt on administrative value)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 157-159 (art. 159 as amended by LF 2023)
entries.doc: art. 159: councils set rates within 4-8 % (built) and 3-7 % (unbuilt); where no rate is adopted, 6 % built and 5 % unbuilt; art. 157: built property on its rental value; art. 158: land on its administrative value.
unsupported: additional levies on top of the TFU (art. 159 3)
temporary exemption of new owner-occupied buildings (art. 154)

entries.name: Registration duty on transfers of immovable property (5 %)
Registration duty on gifts inter vivos (5 %)
Inheritance tax
entries.why: BJ: art. 394 1) — transfers on death are registered free of duty (gifts inter vivos 5 %, modelled)

entries.name: CNSS employer contributions (family benefits 9 %, pensions 6,4 %, occupational risks 1 %)
entries.statute: CNSS Bénin, page 'Recouvrement' (taux de cotisation; Code de sécurité sociale, loi n° 98-019 du 21 mars 2003), held copy w5/bj_cnss_recouvrement.html
entries.doc: CNSS Bénin 'Recouvrement' page (facts restated): family benefits 9 % and occupational risks 1 to 4 % by the firm's activity, both paid by the employer; pension 10 %, of which 6,4 % employer and 3,6 % employee; the base is all the worker's pay (no ceiling).
unsupported: occupational-risk rate by activity (1 to 4 %): the lowest class (1 %) is applied
rates read on the fund's page, not in the decree
